intro.text: A nobleman of House Tekiel in Luthadel.

items.text: Ruined by the house war, House Tekiel tried to leave Luthadel, a show of weakness the other nobles wouldn't allow. House Hasting had some of its leaders assassinated and the rest killed when their canal boats were set on fire, and Kale was apparently among the dead. When Telden Hasting told Elend the war would soon seem trivial, Elend reflected that Kale would never look back on anything.
